# Whisk AI

> > Whisk AI is a Google Labs-powered image remix platform leveraging Gemini and Imagen 3 for creative AI-driven image generation and editing.

Whisk AI combines Google's advanced AI models (Gemini and Imagen 3) to enable users to remix, generate, and edit images through an intuitive interface. The platform is available in 12 languages, making it accessible to a global audience of creative professionals and enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Image Remix
- AI Image Generation
- Google Gemini
- Imagen 3
- Text-to-Image
- Image-to-Image
- Visual Prompts
- Creative Tool
- AI Image Editing
- Google Labs
- Image Manipulation
- Generative AI

## Core Platform

- [Whisk AI - English](https://whisk-ai.io/en): Main English interface for the Google-powered image remix platform using Gemini and Imagen 3
- [Whisk AI - Home](https://whisk-ai.io): Whisk AI homepage: Google Labs-powered image remix platform for creative image generation and editing
